entries.what: Cohere retired the embed-english-v2.0 embedding model.

source.quote: Effective April 4th, 2026, the following models will be retired: embed-english-v2.0 embed-english-light-v2.0 embed-multilingual-v2.0 c4ai-aya-expanse-8b c4ai-aya-vision-8b

lookFor: embed-english-v2.0 passed as the model to Cohere embed. Exclude a list that only records names, and cohere.embed-english-v2.0 on Bedrock.
requires: Set input_type on the call: the API reference says it is required for embedding models v3 and higher, and the v2 models ran without it.
Re-embed what's stored. Reading, not on the page: vectors from different models aren't comparable, and the dimension can differ, so check the size of the vector index too.

entries.what: Cohere retired fine-tuning on the dashboard and the API, and fine-tuned models are no longer accessible.

source.quote: Fine-tuning for the command-light, command, command-r, classify, and rerank models is being retired. This covers both the Cohere dashboard and API. Previously fine-tuned models will no longer be accessible.

lookFor: A request to /v1/finetuning/... on the Cohere API, or a call on the SDK's finetuning client such as co.finetuning.list_finetuned_models(...).
entries.replacement: None listed on the provider page when this was added. The page says to migrate to the recommended alternatives and names no fine-tuning replacement.
requires: A model id that a fine-tune produced stops resolving too, so find where the app stores or passes it and pick a base model in its place.
